Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith Financial Advisory Group specializes in providing comprehensive financial planning and investment advisory services to individuals and businesses. Our team of certified financial planners offers tailored investment strategies, retirement planning, tax optimization, and portfolio management to help clients achieve their financial goals. We prioritize regulatory compliance and adhere to stringent data security measures to safeguard client information. Our services also include regular financial reviews and updates to ensure that our clients' investment strategies remain aligned with their evolving needs and market conditions. With a strong commitment to fiduciary responsibility, we aim to build long-term relationships based on trust and transparency.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On January 20, 2023, Smith Financial Advisory Group experienced a data breach due to a phishing attack that compromised client information, leading to a loss of $10,000 for credit monitoring services. The incident was reported to authorities, and the affected clients were notified. Claims related to this breach were resolved and all clients have been adequately compensated. Status: Resolved. Additionally, on March 15, 2022, the firm faced a professional liability claim concerning investment advice given during a volatile market, resulting in a loss of $5,000 for legal fees related to defense. This claim is currently closed and no further actions are pending. Status: Closed.
